title: A pass can bind a storage image no sync slot transitions; nothing flags it
body: T-2883's 09600 (fixed on lane-ringidx 25d08998): the primary march bound compute_render_target's view as outputImage (writeonly, imageSize() only) with no IMAGE_WRITE/IMAGE_READ declaration, so no pass moved each ring image out of UNDEFINED before the march on that image's first frame (324 reports per look-dev run, uncapped, on Dozen and native 8060S). The fix declares it in the march's IMAGE_WRITE_ARRAY. The class remains open: (1) DirectLighting.comp binds the same image readonly for imageSize() only and relies on the march's transition now; (2) ComputeStageNode IMAGE_READ_ARRAY records no transition, so a reader ordered before an image's first writer is the same bug; (3) the SDI hazard census (SdiHazardCensus.h, observer only) already knows every stage's image members and their providers, and could report an image member whose stage declares no image sync slot on that provider. Proposal: add that report to the census and fail the look-dev validation test family on it. tier:luna because it is several files plus a fixture in existing census code, with no design question.
